units.rawText: In the Pierides Sector, we rested in the Admin Center while communicating with Persicaria.
units.displayText: In the Pierides Sector, we rested in the Admin Center while communicating with Persicaria.

spans.text: In the Pierides Sector, we rested in the Admin Center while communicating with Persicaria.

units.rawText: So, Persicaria, can you break down this virus?
units.displayText: So, Persicaria, can you break down this virus?

spans.text: So, Persicaria, can you break down this virus?

units.rawText: I've done the best I can with the data you've provided... It's not looking good.
units.displayText: I've done the best I can with the data you've provided... It's not looking good.

spans.text: I've done the best I can with the data you've provided... It's not looking good.

units.rawText: The virus attached to these flowers is far too rare. I've never analyzed similar code strings before.
units.displayText: The virus attached to these flowers is far too rare. I've never analyzed similar code strings before.

spans.text: The virus attached to these flowers is far too rare. I've never analyzed similar code strings before.

units.rawText: And this isn't my field of expertise anyway... If only there was a network security expert here.
units.displayText: And this isn't my field of expertise anyway... If only there was a network security expert here.

spans.text: And this isn't my field of expertise anyway... If only there was a network security expert here.

units.rawText: So, your conclusions?
units.displayText: So, your conclusions?

spans.text: So, your conclusions?

units.rawText: Finding a treatment plan isn't realistic in the short-term, but there's not much time either.
units.displayText: Finding a treatment plan isn't realistic in the short-term, but there's not much time either.

spans.text: Finding a treatment plan isn't realistic in the short-term, but there's not much time either.

units.rawText: The speed at which the virus spreads and aggravates is incredible, and if action isn't taken quickly, things might...
units.displayText: The speed at which the virus spreads and aggravates is incredible, and if action isn't taken quickly, things might...

spans.text: The speed at which the virus spreads and aggravates is incredible, and if action isn't taken quickly, things might...

units.rawText: We're at an impasse, then.
units.displayText: We're at an impasse, then.

spans.text: We're at an impasse, then.

units.rawText: We'll have to see as we go. If it's like this...
units.displayText: We'll have to see as we go. If it's like this...

spans.text: We'll have to see as we go. If it's like this...

units.rawText: As I consider my next actions, an exceptionally familiar alert sound fills the sector.
units.displayText: As I consider my next actions, an exceptionally familiar alert sound fills the sector.

spans.text: As I consider my next actions, an exceptionally familiar alert sound fills the sector.

units.rawText: Odile! Odette! <size=40>Come out—</size>！
units.displayText: Odile! Odette! Come out—！

spans.text: Odile! Odette!
Come out—

units.rawText: The Upright Babylon Tower has discovered that two extremely dangerous Irregular Agents have infiltrated Pierides, and administrators must immediately comply with and assist the search!
units.displayText: The Upright Babylon Tower has discovered that two extremely dangerous Irregular Agents have infiltrated Pierides, and administrators must immediately comply with and assist the search!

spans.text: The Upright Babylon Tower has discovered that two extremely dangerous Irregular Agents have infiltrated Pierides, and administrators must immediately comply with and assist the search!

units.rawText: Extremely dangerous Irregular Agents... you know anyone else who fits that description?
units.displayText: Extremely dangerous Irregular Agents... you know anyone else who fits that description?

spans.text: Extremely dangerous Irregular Agents... you know anyone else who fits that description?

units.rawText: She sure recovered fast. Just how enthusiastic is she about work? To the degree of being unwilling to get off work, even.
units.displayText: She sure recovered fast. Just how enthusiastic is she about work? To the degree of being unwilling to get off work, even.

spans.text: She sure recovered fast. Just how enthusiastic is she about work? To the degree of being unwilling to get off work, even.

units.rawText: Professor, Clukay, you should hide. We have a plan.
units.displayText: Professor, Clukay, you should hide. We have a plan.

spans.text: Professor, Clukay, you should hide. We have a plan.

units.rawText: The artist agents are exceptionally insistent, shoving us behind a wall. Just as we finish hiding, Eucharist comes barging in, aura aflame.
units.displayText: The artist agents are exceptionally insistent, shoving us behind a wall. Just as we finish hiding, Eucharist comes barging in, aura aflame.

spans.text: The artist agents are exceptionally insistent, shoving us behind a wall. Just as we finish hiding, Eucharist comes barging in, aura aflame.

units.rawText: ...Apparently without Angelus.
units.displayText: ...Apparently without Angelus.

spans.text: ...Apparently without Angelus.

units.rawText: Are you all deaf? Anyone home?! I don't have all day for this!
units.displayText: Are you all deaf? Anyone home?! I don't have all day for this!

spans.text: Are you all deaf? Anyone home?! I don't have all day for this!

units.rawText: Hehe... Lady Eucharist, I understand that you are in a hurry, but please, don't rush.
units.displayText: Hehe... Lady Eucharist, I understand that you are in a hurry, but please, don't rush.

spans.text: Hehe... Lady Eucharist, I understand that you are in a hurry, but please, don't rush.

units.rawText: Frantically proceeding onwards will only result in failure to live up to the time in which you live. On the beauty of time...
units.displayText: Frantically proceeding onwards will only result in failure to live up to the time in which you live. On the beauty of time...

spans.text: Frantically proceeding onwards will only result in failure to live up to the time in which you live. On the beauty of time...

units.rawText: Alright, let's end the arts lecture there. I've heard enough.
units.displayText: Alright, let's end the arts lecture there. I've heard enough.

spans.text: Alright, let's end the arts lecture there. I've heard enough.

units.rawText: Let's get to business. Those two, have you seen 'em?
units.displayText: Let's get to business. Those two, have you seen 'em?

spans.text: Let's get to business. Those two, have you seen 'em?

units.rawText: Which two? I'm not sure who exactly you refer to...
units.displayText: Which two? I'm not sure who exactly you refer to...

spans.text: Which two? I'm not sure who exactly you refer to...

units.rawText: Sister! Why are you still here? The purple flowers are spreading again, more and more!
units.displayText: Sister! Why are you still here? The purple flowers are spreading again, more and more!

spans.text: Sister! Why are you still here? The purple flowers are spreading again, more and more!

units.rawText: The formerly hidden Odette darted out, tacitly forming an ensemble with her elder sister.
units.displayText: The formerly hidden Odette darted out, tacitly forming an ensemble with her elder sister.

spans.text: The formerly hidden Odette darted out, tacitly forming an ensemble with her elder sister.

units.rawText: Purple... flowers?
units.displayText: Purple... flowers?

spans.text: Purple... flowers?

units.rawText: What of it? Let them grow, is their wild proliferation not a fine complement to the agents' beauty in madness?
units.displayText: What of it? Let them grow, is their wild proliferation not a fine complement to the agents' beauty in madness?

spans.text: What of it? Let them grow, is their wild proliferation not a fine complement to the agents' beauty in madness?

units.rawText: Wait. Purple flowers... could it be Entropy?
units.displayText: Wait. Purple flowers... could it be Entropy?

spans.text: Wait. Purple flowers... could it be Entropy?

units.rawText: —Entropy?
units.displayText: —Entropy?

spans.text: —Entropy?

units.rawText: Seriously, Entropy is the biggest deal! One more for the to-do list... and it's highest priority!
units.displayText: Seriously, Entropy is the biggest deal! One more for the to-do list... and it's highest priority!

spans.text: Seriously, Entropy is the biggest deal! One more for the to-do list... and it's highest priority!

units.rawText: Hm? What big deal? This beauty has only spread across a little less than half the sector...
units.displayText: Hm? What big deal? This beauty has only spread across a little less than half the sector...

spans.text: Hm? What big deal? This beauty has only spread across a little less than half the sector...

units.rawText: That much?! I can't expect anything from a lunatic like you. Odette, lead the way!
units.displayText: That much?! I can't expect anything from a lunatic like you. Odette, lead the way!

spans.text: That much?! I can't expect anything from a lunatic like you. Odette, lead the way!

units.rawText: Ah, but...
units.displayText: Ah, but...

spans.text: Ah, but...

units.rawText: That's a type of virus named Entropy, any longer and it'll really be too late! Take me to where the most flowers are!
units.displayText: That's a type of virus named Entropy, any longer and it'll really be too late! Take me to where the most flowers are!

spans.text: That's a type of virus named Entropy, any longer and it'll really be too late! Take me to where the most flowers are!

units.rawText: Tsk, that annoying deadweight Angelus has been put in the slammer too.
units.displayText: Tsk, that annoying deadweight Angelus has been put in the slammer too.

spans.text: Tsk, that annoying deadweight Angelus has been put in the slammer too.

units.rawText: Whatever, I'll start looking when I get back! Odile, you... at least don't make things any harder!
units.displayText: Whatever, I'll start looking when I get back! Odile, you... at least don't make things any harder!

spans.text: Whatever, I'll start looking when I get back! Odile, you... at least don't make things any harder!

units.rawText: Eucharist leaves in a huff with Odette. Silence returns to the Admin Center, as if the Sanctifiers were never here at all.
units.displayText: Eucharist leaves in a huff with Odette. Silence returns to the Admin Center, as if the Sanctifiers were never here at all.

spans.text: Eucharist leaves in a huff with Odette. Silence returns to the Admin Center, as if the Sanctifiers were never here at all.

units.rawText: She's gone—though I do not know how much time this will grant you.
units.displayText: She's gone—though I do not know how much time this will grant you.

spans.text: She's gone—though I do not know how much time this will grant you.

units.rawText: What a wonderful unison, or should I say... as expected between sisters?
units.displayText: What a wonderful unison, or should I say... as expected between sisters?

spans.text: What a wonderful unison, or should I say... as expected between sisters?

units.rawText: Truly competent as actors.
units.displayText: Truly competent as actors.

spans.text: Truly competent as actors.

units.rawText: Data and neural clouds of the same source, and companionship and trust honed by time. Given an implicit understanding of the other, you can do it too.
units.displayText: Data and neural clouds of the same source, and companionship and trust honed by time. Given an implicit understanding of the other, you can do it too.

spans.text: Data and neural clouds of the same source, and companionship and trust honed by time. Given an implicit understanding of the other, you can do it too.

units.rawText: I can...
units.displayText: I can...

spans.text: I can...

units.rawText:
Clukay raises her eyes to look at me in a manner she thought was inconspicuous, though she did not go further than that.
I pat her on the shoulder, smiling—not rejected this time.
units.displayText:
Clukay raises her eyes to look at me in a manner she thought was inconspicuous, though she did not go further than that.
I pat her on the shoulder, smiling—not rejected this time.

spans.text:
Clukay raises her eyes to look at me in a manner she thought was inconspicuous, though she did not go further than that.
I pat her on the shoulder, smiling—not rejected this time.

units.rawText: Let's go, we'll retrace the way we came. Eucharist's already here, and the same strategy won't work twice.
units.displayText: Let's go, we'll retrace the way we came. Eucharist's already here, and the same strategy won't work twice.

spans.text: Let's go, we'll retrace the way we came. Eucharist's already here, and the same strategy won't work twice.

units.rawText: We need to find somewhere safe to strategize for the long term.
units.displayText: We need to find somewhere safe to strategize for the long term.

spans.text: We need to find somewhere safe to strategize for the long term.
